component.name: Keepcut
component.summary: Cut and join video clips losslessly

description.p: Mark the parts of your clips to keep, then cut and join them without re-encoding. Only the few frames at a cut that does not fall on a keyframe are re-encoded (smart cut), so exports are fast and keep the original quality.

ul.li: Frame-accurate preview with mpv, including a preview of the joined result
Joined or separate outputs, chapters, and a ready-to-paste YouTube chapter list
Loudness normalization per clip, per segment, or for the whole output
